title: Brainstorm
summary: Options for one person to read once and pick by number.

facets.label: How it works
facets.hint: The mechanism, concretely: what exists afterwards that does not exist now.

facets.label: Why
facets.hint: The value, and for whom. This is what the reader weighs when picking.

facets.label: In use
facets.hint: What someone sees or does differently once it ships.

facets.label: Unlocks
facets.hint: What it makes possible next, by idea number where it helps.

facets.label: Risk
facets.hint: What could go wrong, and how you would notice.

facets.label: Note
facets.hint: Anything the reader must know that fits nowhere else.

sections.title: Thesis
sections.hint: The purpose and the constraint, in a paragraph or two.

sections.title: Ideas
sections.hint: Every idea, numbered, with the summary table on.

sections.title: Also considered
sections.hint: Ideas left out, one line each saying why not.

legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

decision.title: How to pick
decision.markdown: Reply with the numbers you want, plus notes on anything to change.
